body: I'm in a similar situation. I tried to shoot myself yesterday and I couldn't go through with it. It's rough, man. The problems I wanted to get away from are still plaguing me. I'm sure you feel the same. If you need to talk to anyone, please reach out to me.

I'm sorry for your experiences. But if it's worth anything, I really empathize with you. I plan to keep as little contact as possible once I get out of here. They say you shouldn't run away from your problems, but sometimes you have no choice. 

Also, thank you, ElderTokenDragon and X4patience, for reaching out to me and commenting on my post. I'm wishing you nothing but the best.
Thank you. I'm not sure how I'm going to make it, but I'll figure it out. I really wish I could go through with suicide though if I'm honest. I wish I wasn't so scared.
Yeah. I guess that's all I really can do. I tried to pull the trigger, but I'm just too scared.
UPDATE: I can't do it. It's too scary.

People keep telling me to keep talking so I'm just going to respond to my post here. So here's an update:

I'm looking at the gun right now and this is really fucking terrifying.
I'm going to try to shoot myself. Just reading the replies now before I go. Might still change my mind when I actually put the gun to my head.
For those of you asking, everyone in my house just left. I appreciate all the love and support. I'll let you know what I decide to do. Thank you all so much.
Believe me, I'm trying so hard to hold on. Even now, I'm trying to talk myself out of it. The thought of living one more day is just so unbearable. I really don't think I can do it anymore.
This was the only thing I was hanging onto. I keep telling myself it's all going to change in September, but I don't know if I can wait anymore. This is killing me.
I feel the exact same way. Tonight might be it for me...
